title: Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with former employee of Manufacturers and Traders Trust Company
raw_text:
June 18, 2026
Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with former employee of Manufacturers and Traders Trust Company
For release at 11:00 a.m. EDT
The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday announced the execution of the enforcement action listed below:
Consent prohibition order against Matthew Cheong
Former employee of Manufacturers and Traders Trust Company
Embezzlement by bank employee
Additional enforcement actions can be searched for here.
